name: poker-mals
description: Simulador de mesa de poker com fichas virtuais (sem valor monetario real)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npm run start -w server
